posts.title: It is August: notes from a year ago
posts.description: Just now I came across some notes I wrote exactly one year ago, on August 11, 2025; perhaps they are worth sharing. It is August; the weather is hot, and I live in a house with no functioning air conditioner; instead, I use fans, not to keep cool, but to make the heat more bearable. […]
